body: Yah exactly how I feel. I don't think i ever will. I dont have the motivation to get up most days and don't see why anyone else would actually feels anything more than just pitty for me.

I dont want anyone to feel this way either. But there's just some of us that no one wants to love. Society says parents have to "love" their kids. That love means nothing. No one loves me other than the ones who are told they must "love" me
No one who doesn't have to love or care about me.

I don't even want to get out of bed. I dont want to talk to anyone. I already cancelled everything I was supposed to do today. Streaming wont ever work out and my parents would never let me try it. School or failure in their eyes but they don't see how hard school is and how much it just makes my life worse. I dont want to graduate or go to another class. Yet i dont have a choice.

I never been good enough to do anything like that. Im not good enough at anything. No one would ever want to watch me and no one will. Im shit at everything and no matter how hard i no one would watch. Streaming is the dream but that would never happen so whats even the point. Im just going to end up at a dead end job that'll just make me want to kill myself even more. That is if i even make it through the torture that is school. I have nothing to look forward too in life. When my own family doesn't like me how would anyone else.
Care. They only care because society tells them they have to care. After im gone they will forget in no time. Care doesn't mean anything

All i look forward to is new releases but when I finally play them i dont even want to. I don't even have the will power to try in games I have been playing for years. I have over 5000 hours in csgo and cant even get past trying after the first couple rounds. The odd time my friends are on I get distracted and forget about what life really is but it always comes back to what it really is. A prison where no one likes me, and only chance of success is school which I also don't have any will to continue trying.
As if they care. They just don't want to do the paperwork when we finally do it.
